description: Generic authenticated request to ANY backend route. Path is relative to the API base (e.g. '/projects' or 'admin/users'). Use list_endpoints to discover paths. Non-GET methods are blocked when MCP_READONLY is set. Returns { status, ok, request, data } including error envelopes.

path.description: Path relative to API base, e.g. /projects/123 or admin/stats

name: api_request
title: Call any API endpoint
